adjudication.rationale: The finding is correct. Looking at lines 1063-1067 in handleNewBooking.ts, `evt.destinationCalendar` is set to `null` when neither `eventType.destinationCalendar` nor `organizerUser.destinationCalendar` exists. Then at line 1078, the code does `evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars)` which uses optional chaining. When `destinationCalendar` is `null`, the optional chaining causes the push to be silently skipped, meaning `teamDestinationCalendars` (containing secondary hosts' destination calendars for collective bookings) are never added. This is a real bug where collective team bookings won't create calendar events for secondary hosts when the organizer/event type has no destination calendar configured.
